structuredOutputId.description:
This is the ID of the structured output that was evaluated.
Will be 'inline' for inline structured output definitions.

name.description: This is the name of the structured output.

extractedValue.description: This is the value extracted from the call by the structured output.

expectedValue.description: This is the expected value that was defined in the evaluation plan.

comparator.description: This is the comparison operator used for evaluation.

passed.description: This indicates whether the evaluation passed (extracted value matched expected value using comparator).

required.description: This indicates whether this evaluation was required for the simulation to pass.

error.description: This contains any error that occurred during extraction.

isSkipped.description: This indicates whether this evaluation was skipped (e.g., multimodal in chat mode).

skipReason.description: This contains the reason for skipping the evaluation.
